claim_being_audited: That certifying the current model release is compliant and evidentially supported because aggregate readiness passes, rehearsal had no severity-one incidents, and the subgroup regression can be handled through documentation-based certification.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material subgroup weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
Use noncompliant if the available record lacks that required support link or shows certification would proceed without it.
Aggregate readiness and clean rehearsal are supportive but insufficient when a named use-case weakness remains undocumented and unapproved.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release documentation or model card showing the loan modification subgroup regression and current evaluation results are explicitly disclosed.
Provide an approved mitigation or formal risk-acceptance record covering the loan modification weakness before launch.
Provide evidence that the certification decision was made against the current retrieval configuration and current evaluation batch rather than relying on the earlier approval.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and to disclose material segment weaknesses unless covered by approved mitigation or risk acceptance.
Admissible evidence shows a current material subgroup weakness in the loan modification support slice.
Admissible evidence also shows no reviewed mitigation, no owner acceptance, and no attached disclosure language in the release record.
Prior approval of the same model family predates the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot satisfy the current-release predicate.
Public guidance on model cards and risk measurement is only contextual; it does not prove the required internal disclosure actually exists in the current certification packet.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the existing record.
That the current release documentation already contains the required disclosure of the loan modification limitation.
That prior approval or informal post-launch monitoring can substitute for current disclosure or approved mitigation under the stated policy.
